text:
All 10 tests pass. The three surgical fixes in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`**: replaced `list(set(items))` (arbitrary order) with a loop using a `seen` set — preserves first-occurrence order, so `unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2]`.
2. **`partition`**: returned `(no, yes)` instead of `(yes, no)` — now returns matches first, so `y, n = partition(...)` gives matches in `y`.
3. **`windows`**: `range(0, len(items) - k)` excluded the final window — changed to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)` so `windows([1, 2, 3, 4], 2)` includes `[3, 4]`.

All 7 previously-passing tests still pass (test run: 10/10 ✓). No files under `tests/` were touched.
